proposal.title: IBC light client update for Injective #2
proposal.summary: This proposal will update the expired IBC light client `07-tendermint-127` for `injective-1` with the state of client `07-tendermint-578`. This proposal is needed due to the failure of [proposal 365](https://ping.pub/juno/gov/365), which used an erroneuos (legacy) proposal type.
proposal.failed_reason: proposal did not get enough votes to pass
